_comment: Repository-root config: what an editor opens at the top of the tree, and the config that covers loose root-level TypeScript — the repository scripts in `scripts/` among them, since a checker nobody type checks is a checker that breaks silently. Each workspace also type checks itself through its own tsconfig.json; `bun run typecheck` runs this file first and then fans out.
$comment_react: packages/components/src/react is excluded here because this config covers loose repository TypeScript and does not set `jsx` or the DOM lib, so it cannot compile a `.tsx`. Reaching `react/index.ts` from `packages/*/src/**/*.ts` pulls its `.tsx` imports in behind it and fails with `--jsx is not set`. That package's own tsconfig sets both and includes `src/**/*.tsx`, so the React sources are checked there — by tsc, with real types.
$comment_svelte: There was a matching exclusion for `packages/components/src/svelte` until Phase 6 layer 5 deleted those sources. It was there because tsc cannot resolve a `.svelte` import and the ambient `declare module '*.svelte'` workaround types every primitive as `any`; svelte-check covered them instead. Nothing in this repository needs either mechanism now.
